tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Antimicrobial activity of Spgillcin177–189 against microorganisms.
footnotes: China General Microbiological Culture Collection Center.

The values of MIC were expressed as the interval [a]-[b]. [a] was the highest concentration tested with visible microbial growth, whereas [b] was determined as the lowest concentration without visible microbial growth.
The values of MBC presented are those wherein the peptide concentration killed 99.99% of the bacteria.
